title: SMS reminder sender: backoff that ignores the gateway's Retry-After
name: SMS retry backoff

questions.prompt: The SMS provider emailed us: our account repeatedly ignored 429 responses during the 4 pm reservation-reminder run, sending retries within a second when Retry-After asked for 10 to 60 seconds, and we have been put on a stricter rate limit. The same run marked hundreds of reminders as failed after using up all their attempts inside the throttling window. Fix sms/retry.ts so the tests pass.
